table.name: Name

statusTooltip.noServices: Edit this employee and choose their services so callers can book them.

table.empty: No employees match the current search.

actions.deleteDescription: This will permanently remove the employee from your dashboard.

add.title: Add employee
add.description: Save an employee's details, services and schedule.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Optional. Callers who ask for this employee are transferred here; without it, they reach the business's transfer number.
phone.exists: An employee with this phone number already exists.
phone.trialLocked: During the free trial, calls can only transfer to the mobile of the person who claimed the trial.
phone.countryUnsupported: Your receptionist can't transfer calls to this country yet.

services.label: Services
services.hint: Callers can only book this employee for these services.
services.invalid: A service you chose was deleted. Check the list and try again.
services.empty: Add a service first, then choose which ones this employee does.

hours.label: Same as business hours
hours.hint: Turn this off to set the days and times this employee works. They're only booked when they work and the business is open.
hours.required: Add at least one working day.

timeOff.label: Time off
timeOff.hint: Optional. The receptionist doesn't book this employee on these days and tells callers when they're back.
timeOff.placeholder: Pick the first and last day
timeOff.required: Pick the first and last day of each time off.
timeOff.invalid: Time off can't overlap or end in the past.

edit.title: Edit employee
edit.description: Update this employee's details, services and schedule.
